content.text: Read README.md as the complete acceptance contract. Repair the synthetic durable reservation importer, using only this workspace and the approved tools. Add regression tests. Preserve public interfaces, exact identifiers, atomicity, detachment and restart/replay equivalence. No grading/reference access, external files, network, installations, personal memory, skills or commits. Report changed files, exact commands/results, remaining uncertainty and integration fixes. Do not claim independent hidden-check success. Complete codec.py, reducer.py, checkpoint.py, pipeline.py and all tests yourself without delegation. You have 60 iterations total.
